previous_definition: sum of effective responsibility weights attached to positive-amplitude observations
cache_storage_correction: Persist canonical_feature and log_amplitude, but derive semantic_direction as normalize(canonical_feature) instead of duplicating a second N x D tensor.
reason: Raw responsibility mass depends on image resolution, projected primitive footprint, and compositing scale, so it is not a scene-comparable observation-evidence scalar. The bounded positive-view count matches the existing canonical primitive reliability semantics and is invariant to a common positive rescaling of responsibility and visibility weights. Semantic direction is exactly derivable from the nonzero canonical feature, so persisting it would double the dominant cache storage without adding information.
